questions.question: Mount Kanlaon, recently seen in the news due to volcanic activity, is located in:
questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Mount Kanlaon, an active volcano in the Philippines, recently erupted, drawing attention to volcanic risks in the Pacific Ring of Fire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Mount Kanlaon** is a **stratovolcano** located in the **north-central part of Negros Island, Philippines**. **Hence, option 2 is correct. **
 
• It is one of the **most active volcanoes** in the Philippines and is part of the **Pacific Ring of Fire**, a major area in the basin of the Pacific Ocean where many earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.
 
• The summit contains a **broad caldera** with a crater lake and a smaller, higher **active crater**.
 
• It is geologically composed of **sheeted lava flows**, **lahar deposits**, **airfall tephra**, and **pyroclastic materials**.
 
• The region around Mount Kanlaon is **biologically diverse** and serves as a **critical water catchment** for major river systems on Negros Island.
 
• Historical eruptions, recorded since **1866**, have typically involved **phreatic (steam-driven) explosions** producing minor ashfalls. **Additional Information: **
 
• Other major active volcanoes in the Philippines include **Mount Mayon**, **Taal Volcano**, and **Mount Pinatubo**.
 
• The **Pacific Ring of Fire** is home to about **75% of the world's active and dormant volcanoes**.

questions.question: Diego Garcia, recently seen in the news, is located in:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Fifteen Kanniyakumari fishermen were detained near Diego Garcia, a part of the British Indian Ocean Territory, for allegedly crossing the maritime boundary.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Location: **Diego Garcia is situated in the Indian Ocean, south of the equator, approximately 1,796 km south of India and 4,723 km east of Africa. ***Hence, option 2 is correct.***
 
• **Significance:** It is part of the British Indian Ocean Territory (BIOT) and hosts a major U.S. military base crucial for operations in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.
 
• **Historical Background: **Originally inhabited by Chagossians, descendants of African and Indian laborers, it became a British colony in 1814. The sovereignty of the island is disputed by Mauritius, and the UN has supported its claim.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Strategic Importance:** The U.S. military base at Diego Garcia serves as a logistics and intelligence hub, supporting long-range bombers and other military operations.
 
• **Geopolitical Dispute:** In 2019, the International Court of Justice (ICJ) advised the U.K. to return the Chagos Archipelago, including Diego Garcia, to Mauritius, a ruling endorsed by the UN General Assembly.
 
• **Environmental Note: **Diego Garcia is surrounded by coral reefs and is considered ecologically sensitive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.britannica.com/80/77380-004-22D70FF4/map-2004-military-airbase-island-location-2004.jpg]

questions.question: Which one of the following countries has developed its own Global Positioning System (GPS) alternative?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is **Option 1. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Russia has developed its own satellite navigation system known as GLONASS (Global Navigation Satellite System), which serves as an alternative to the U.S. GPS. **Hence, option 1 is correct.**
 
• The United Kingdom, South Korea, and Brazil do not have independent global satellite navigation systems, though they may rely on or collaborate with existing systems like GPS, GLONASS, or others.

questions.question: The Perito Moreno Glacier, often called the ‘White Giant’, is located in which of the following?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The Perito Moreno Glacier, known for its enormous size and striking ice calving events, is currently crumbling due to rising global temperatures, highlighting concerns over glacier retreat worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Perito Moreno Glacier is located in Los Glaciares National Park in the Argentine province of Santa Cruz. It lies in the Andes Mountains and is part of a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 
• The glacier has a surface area of about 250 sq km and is approximately 30 km long. Hence, Option B is correct.
 
• It was formed during the last Ice Age, about 18,000 years ago.
 
• The glacier is a major freshwater source for Argentina.
 
• It is famous for large-scale ice calving events that attract global tourists.
 
• The glacier’s retreat is a visible impact of climate change.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Perito Moreno is one of the few glaciers worldwide that is still advancing, but recent signs indicate it is now shrinking.
 
• The largest glacier in the world is the Lambert Glacier, located in Antarctica.

questions.question: India's first solar-powered village is located in which state?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• India's first solar-powered village is **Modhera**, located in Gujarat.
 
• Modhera village became solar-powered as part of a project implemented by the **Government of Gujarat** and the **Government of India**.
 
• The village uses **solar energy for its electricity needs**, including houses, streets, and even agriculture.
 
• The project was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi in **October 2022**.
 
• Modhera is also famous for the **Sun Temple**, which aligns with its solar-powered identity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Solar Energy**

 
 
• Solar energy is harnessed from the **sun's radiation** and converted into electricity using technologies like **photovoltaic panels**.
 
• It is a clean, renewable source of energy and plays a key role in reducing carbon footprints.
 
 
 
• **India's Solar Initiatives**
 
 
• India has set ambitious targets under its **National Solar Mission**, aiming for 100 GW of solar capacity by 2022.
 
• The country is one of the founding members of the **International Solar Alliance (ISA)**, which promotes solar energy worldwide.
 
 
 
• **Sun Temple in Modhera**
 
 
• The Sun Temple in Modhera, Gujarat, is a **11th-century architectural marvel** dedicated to the Sun God.
 
• The temple's design is aligned with solar phenomena, making Modhera a symbolic location for solar energy projects.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Solar-Powered Villages**
 
 
• Solar-powered villages reduce dependency on fossil fuels and promote **sustainable development**.
 
• They provide uninterrupted electricity to rural areas, benefiting homes, schools, and agriculture.

questions.question: In which district of Haryana will the country's first styrene plant be set up?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Panipat**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The country's first styrene plant will be set up in **Panipat** district of Haryana.
 
• Panipat is already known for its significant industrial activities, which will be further enhanced by the establishment of this plant.
 
• Styrene is an important chemical used in the production of plastics, rubber, and resins, making this plant a crucial addition to the industrial landscape of the region.
 
• The plant is expected to boost local employment and contribute to the economic development of Panipat and its surrounding areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Panipat is historically known as the site of three major battles in Indian history, which were fought in 1526, 1556, and 1761.
 
• It is often referred to as the "City of Weavers" due to its thriving handloom and textile industries.
 
• The city is strategically located near the national capital, Delhi, which adds to its importance as a major industrial hub.
 
• Panipat also houses one of the largest oil refineries in India, further cementing its status as a key industrial center.

questions.question: The Polavaram Irrigation Project, recently seen in news, is situated on which of the following rivers?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The project, located in Andhra Pradesh, is being developed as a national project under the Andhra Pradesh State Reorganization Act, 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The Polavaram Irrigation Project is situated on the river Godavari.
 
• Conceived under the recommendations of the Godavari Water Disputes Tribunal (GWDT), the project involves Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, and Odisha.
 
• It aims to provide irrigation, hydroelectric power, and drinking water benefits.
 
• The project has faced criticism over submergence levels affecting Odisha’s Malkangiri district, potentially displacing tribal communities and causing environmental challenges. ***Hence, option 2 is correct.***

questions.question: Lipulekh Pass, recently in the news, is located in which Indian state and connects which two regions?

options.text: Arunachal Pradesh; connects India and Myanmar
Himachal Pradesh; connects India and Afghanistan

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lipulekh Pass is located in Pithoragarh district, Uttarakhand. *Hence, option 2 is correct.***
 
• It lies near the tri-junction of India, China (Tibet), and Nepal.
 
• It is an important Himalayan pass of the Kumaon region in the Kali Valley.
 
• It serves as a key route for the Kailash Mansarovar pilgrimage and was historically used for India-China border trade. ***Hence, option 2 is correct.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c13c22f34135b0b5ee682fac484427eb7023005c9820d306a5421bea0db90882.png]
